long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Athens, Tsouvelekakis studied at the Athens University of Economics and Business before entering retail. He developed fashion operations around Replay and Brooks Brothers across Greece, Monaco, Cyprus and Romania, then joined other entrepreneurs in creating Attica Department Stores. The venture grew into a major Greek department-store group, where he served as non-executive chair and retained material indirect ownership.

Property development is now a second long-term focus. As a founder and principal shareholder of Hellenic Estates, he backs Skyline Havens within The Ellinikon, a large urban-regeneration project in Athens. The shift builds on real-estate activity across several European markets while preserving his retail holdings and board relationships. His career is defined by cross-border brand building, founder ownership and long-term capital deployment.
